title: NEXSOLVE Packet and Flow Feature Specification
status: Design only; implementation and PCAP verification pending

windowing.assignment: floor(packet_timestamp / 60 seconds) using UTC-normalized packet timestamps
windowing.bidirectional_flow_key: canonicalize the two endpoint directions while retaining directional counters
windowing.missing_value_policy: Use explicit missing indicators for unavailable protocol fields; do not silently convert unavailable packet evidence to zero.

packet_features.name: packet_count
packet_features.definition: count of packets assigned to the window

packet_features.name: mean_packet_size
packet_features.definition: mean captured or wire packet length; choose one definition and record it

packet_features.name: std_packet_size
packet_features.definition: population standard deviation of packet size

packet_features.name: mean_ttl
packet_features.definition: mean IP TTL across IP packets
packet_features.source: IPv4 TTL or IPv6 hop limit, with protocol-specific provenance

packet_features.name: mean_tcp_window
packet_features.definition: mean advertised TCP window, with scaling policy documented

packet_features.name: std_tcp_window
packet_features.definition: standard deviation of advertised TCP window

packet_features.name: fragment_count
packet_features.definition: packets carrying IPv4 fragment offset or MF flag; define IPv6 fragmentation separately

packet_features.name: retransmission_count
packet_features.definition: deterministic duplicate TCP sequence-range evidence within canonical flow, with SYN/FIN and out-of-order rules documented
packet_features.verification: inferred, not a native packet field; must validate against analyzer semantics

packet_features.name: mean_iat
packet_features.definition: mean delta between consecutive packet timestamps in the window, with per-flow and global policy recorded

packet_features.name: std_iat
packet_features.definition: standard deviation of consecutive packet timestamp deltas

flow_feature_rules.duration: packet-flow last timestamp minus first timestamp; do not use labels
flow_feature_rules.bytes: sum packet lengths, with captured versus original length explicitly selected
flow_feature_rules.attack_ratio: label-derived evaluation metadata only; never an input feature for forecasting
flow_feature_rules.protocol_counts: fixed vocabulary plus other/unknown bucket fitted without future data

features_not_yet_verified: TTL fields in the selected capture
TCP window scaling and option coverage
payload definition under truncation or encryption
determinism: sort by timestamp then stable packet index
define duplicate packets and retransmission rules
fit vocabularies/scalers on training period only
write extractor manifest with source hash and parser settings
